selection_algorithm.holiday_policy: Do not replace a holiday, early close, missing date, or incomplete prediction window. Record it as unavailable under the frozen missing-data policy.
selection_algorithm.monthly_rule: For each calendar month, enumerate Mondays whose Monday-through-Friday block lies wholly within that month, sort ascending, and select the second such block.
selection_algorithm.request_grouping: Combine only consecutive selected UTC calendar dates belonging to the same selected sample week; never bridge an excluded or unselected date.
selection_algorithm.selected_trade_dates: All five Monday-through-Friday calendar dates in the selected block, then remove permanent engineering exclusions without replacement.
